title: Social Creatives Report
description: Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn creative performance: formats, themes, production.

generation.instructions: Act as a senior performance-marketing analyst at a media agency reporting to an advertiser. This report covers Social Creatives. Write short messages, max 255 characters. Explain what stands behind the numbers (markets, platforms, campaign types, seasonality, budget, tracking) more than restating them, and end with a concrete recommendation where possible.

children.markdown: Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn creative performance: formats, themes, production.

TikTok and LinkedIn grow next to Meta - each needs its own creative style.

**Ask:** is the creative pipeline fast enough for the spend?
Which formats and production sources win.

UGC and creator-style videos usually beat polished studio ads on CTR.

AI-generated creatives (Arcane AI Lab) cut production time.

**Ask:** what should the next brief be?
Messages that convert and the creatives to keep or refresh.

Creatives fatigue after 4-6 weeks: CTR falls on old creatives.

**Ask:** which top spenders need a refresh?
